name: Anthropic Chat
description: Chat with Anthropic Claude models using the native Anthropic API. API key resolution prefers the caller/public secret store (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY by default), then the venue process environment; override by passing apiKey explicitly or as 's/<SECRET_NAME>'. Supports system prompts, tools, and structured output. Prompt caching is on by default: tools, system prompt and the caller's cacheMarks are cache breakpoints; usage reports cacheRead and cacheWrite tokens.
creator: Covia

messages.description: Chat messages (advanced mode). A user message's content may be a string, or an array of content blocks for vision. PREFERRED for images: reference stored content — {type:'image', source:{type:'asset', ref:'a/<hash> | w/<path> | dlfs/<drive>/<path> | did:...'}} — resolved at call time under your authority, so the job record keeps a tiny reference instead of megabytes of image data (store once via asset_store, content-address deduped). Inline also supported for small images: {type:'image', source:{type:'base64', mediaType:'image/jpeg', data:'...'}}. Text blocks: {type:'text', text:'...'}

model.description: Model name. Sonnet 5 is the balanced default; Opus 5 targets complex agentic work, Fable 5 the longest and hardest work, and Haiku 4.5 economical or latency-sensitive work.

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key (resolved from the secret store, then process environment, by default — see operation.secretKey)

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (e.g. 0 for deterministic extraction); provider default when omitted

topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p; provider default when omitted

maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the response (bounds cost/latency; e.g. 1024 for extraction calls). Provider default when omitted.

cache.description: Prompt caching (default true): the tool definitions and the system prompt are marked as cache breakpoints and cacheMarks are honoured. Set false to disable caching for this call.

cacheMarks.description: Indices of messages to mark as prompt-cache breakpoints (ephemeral, 5-minute TTL), placed on each message's last content block. The agent runtime marks the conversation as it stood when the cycle began and the tool loop so far; with the system prompt and tools that is the maximum of four.
